Reconnect • Restore • Educate • Empower
Feminine Wellness • Yoni Steaming • Herbal Education • Practitioner Training﻿

Creating spaces for women to reconnect with their bodies, deepen their understanding of feminine wellness and share in the traditional practice of yoni steaming.

Angie Meagher is the founder of Yoni Steam Australia, a feminine wellness practice dedicated to education, empowerment and helping women reconnect with their bodies through the traditional practice of yoni steaming.

Angie's own journey into this work began through her personal experiences with women's health. After navigating challenges including endometriosis, PCOS, surgeries, an ectopic pregnancy, miscarriage and ongoing hormonal difficulties, Angie discovered yoni steaming in 2019 as part of her own exploration of holistic wellness.

What began as a personal journey grew into a passion for supporting other women. Angie has since guided hundreds of women through one-on-one yoni steaming sessions and consultations, developing Yoni Steam Australia into a space for feminine wellness, herbal education, practitioner training and women's connection.

Her approach combines traditional knowledge, herbal education, lived experience and personalised care, with an emphasis on understanding each woman's individual needs rather than following a one-size-fits-all approach.

🌹﻿ BECOME A YONI STEAM PRACTITIONER 🌹﻿

Angie's flagship offering - a comprehensive Yoni Steam Practitioner Training for women wanting to deepen their knowledge or incorporate yoni steaming into an existing wellness practice.

No previous wellness experience is required. The training is designed for both experienced practitioners and women who are completely new to this work.

The training covers:
🌿 History and origins of yoni steaming
🌙 Women's cycles and the infradian rhythm
🌿 Herbal knowledge and blend customisation
⚠️ Safety and contraindications
🫶 Client consultation
🌸 Personalised steaming protocols
✨ Holding sacred space
💬 Client communication and aftercare
💼 Building and integrating a professional practice

The program is self-paced and includes online learning modules, live webinars, a physical Yoni Steaming Guide & Workbook and a one-on-one call with Angie.

Upon successful completion, students receive a personalised Yoni Steam Australia certificate of completion, access to the alumni community and ongoing support.

PRACTITIONER TRAINING INVESTMENT
$2,200
Afterpay is available, with personalised payment plans also available by arrangement with Angie.


✨ WHY TRAIN WITH ANGIE?

🌿 Lived Experience
Angie's teaching comes from her own journey into yoni steaming, combined with years of practice and experience supporting women.

🌸 Personalised Education
Rather than simply teaching a generic protocol, the training explores individualised approaches, herbal knowledge, consultation and contraindications.

🌿 Herbal Knowledge
Students learn about herbs, their properties, appropriate applications and contraindications so they can approach herbal steaming with greater knowledge and care.

🫶 Real Support
Students receive more than online content, with live webinars, a personal call with Angie and ongoing community support after completing the training.

🌹 Community
Graduates become part of the growing Yoni Steam Australia practitioner and alumni community, connecting with other women doing this work throughout Australia.


🌿 ABOUT YONI STEAMING 🌹﻿

Yoni steaming is a traditional feminine self-care ritual involving sitting over warm, herb-infused steam.

The practice has historical roots across several cultures, including traditions from Africa, Asia and Central America. Yoni Steam Australia approaches the practice through a combination of traditional knowledge, herbal education and modern wellness education.

Angie's approach is personalised, with herbal blends selected according to a woman's individual circumstances, cycle and wellness goals.

Herbal education is a central part of Angie's work, including understanding the properties of individual herbs, appropriate combinations and contraindications.

Yoni steaming is offered as a feminine wellness and self-care practice, with education around appropriate use and safety.


🌸 PERSONALISED FEMININE WELLNESS

Angie's work supports women to develop a deeper understanding of their:

🌿 Bodies
🌙 Menstrual cycles
🌸 Feminine wellbeing
🌿 Herbal practices
🫶 Self-care rituals
✨ Mind-body connection

Each woman's experience is different, which is why consultation and personalised guidance are an important part of the Yoni Steam Australia approach.


🌹 WOMEN'S CIRCLES, WORKSHOPS & EVENTS

Yoni Steam Australia also creates spaces for women's connection, education and community.

Angie facilitates and collaborates on:

• Yoni steaming circles
• Women's wellness workshops
• Retreats
• Women's health gatherings
• Hens parties
• Group experiences
• Collaborative wellness events

Wellness practitioners, event organisers and brands can also collaborate with Yoni Steam Australia to create bespoke workshops, retreats and women's wellness experiences.


🌿 HOME YONI STEAMING & HERBAL EDUCATION

Yoni Steam Australia also provides education and products for women who wish to explore yoni steaming as part of their home wellness practice.

This includes herbal blends, steaming equipment and education around appropriate steaming practices.

For women with individual health concerns or questions about whether steaming is appropriate for them, personalised guidance is recommended.

🌺 A NOTE ON YONI STEAMING

Yoni steaming is a traditional wellness and self-care practice and should not be considered a substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment.

Appropriate use, individual circumstances and contraindications should always be considered before steaming.
